text: Commissioning complete: 5 cryoberths, 1 rover chassis, no promise of a safe destination. VELLA expands to Vessel Environment, Life-support and Log Arbitration; Ryoma says the shortened name should survive a power failure.
Captain archive imported: born 2010, departed in 2030 aged 20. The old 2026-10-15 was a real day he remembers, aged 16, not his last ordinary day on Earth.

First voyage reconstruction: 60 [physics:trip1.earth_years] Earth years, 13.303136 [physics:trip1.ship_years] proper years, 10.303136 [physics:trip1.cryo_years] cryo years and assumed 3.0 [physics:trip1.awake_years] awake years. Return age approximately twenty-three; Earth/body ratio is not gamma.

Ozone crisis preceded the impacts: solar particle events compounded severe geomagnetic weakening, UV exposure and crop failures. The unmagnetised M-dwarf ozone model is an analogy, not an Earth measurement.
2024 YR4 struck the Moon in this alternate history on 2032-12-22. Ejecta and satellite collisions helped ground launches; the historical lunar-risk estimate was never a guaranteed prediction.
Five aboard: Ryoma Rook Tachibana, commander/repair; Hana Sato, physician/cryo; Imani Vale, propulsion; Pavel Orlov, navigation; Leena Das, air/water. Captain Rook is his callsign, not a second man.

Optical/radio confirmation received: fictional impactor 2090 BA1 has struck the old Earth. Light delay 0.176538 [physics:signal.delay_days] days at receiver distance 30.566613 [physics:signal.receiver_distance_AU] AU; the living world is lost, not the planet’s rock.

Rook asks me to preserve 5 voices, not just the mission objectives. Sealed habitats, UV shelters and famine had already made his 2090 homecoming unrecognisable; evacuation did not give him his old Earth back.

Proxima Centauri is M5.5V, catalogue distance 4.24 [physics:catalog.proxima.distance_ly] ly from Sol. Rest-to-rest approach to Proxima b ends after 5.865270 [physics:route.legs.proxima.arrival_earth_elapsed] Earth years; braking was paid for.

Shield load 117 [physics:shield.event_percent]% = 1.170e+08 [physics:shield.event_W] W on my reference scale, below rated 1.500e+08 [physics:shield.rated_W] W. The event used 78.0 [physics:shield.rated_utilization_percent]% of rating; serious power, valid reading, no overload.

Alpha Centauri primary G2V, 4.34 [physics:catalog.alpha.distance_ly] ly from Sol. Catalogue-vector separation from Proxima is 0.191693 [physics:route.legs.alpha.distance_ly] ly; subtracting the Sol distances would be wrong.

Luhman 16 is the catalogue L8 brown-dwarf entry, 6.51 [physics:catalog.luhman.distance_ly] ly from Sol. Alpha-to-Luhman vector distance 3.580982 [physics:route.legs.luhman.distance_ly] ly; mission annotation: Not Even a Real Star.

Local manoeuvring reserve is separate from relativistic transfer work. The next detour leg is 30.0 [physics:route.legs.turn.distance_ly] ly with full braking; fusion and Asterion still owe the work ledger.

Actual itinerary peak gamma 31.979437 [physics:route.peak_gamma]; ambient proton kinetic energy 29.067141 [physics:medium.route.proton_GeV] GeV. The straight second-trip reference peak 28.157419 [physics:trip2.peak_gamma] is a different worldline, not another unlogged voyage.

NSB-Rook-A/B, fictional dark binary; planned component periapsis 12000 [physics:tidal.planned_radius_km] km, span gradient 0.219215 [physics:tidal.planned_g] g. Rook calls it a fuel-star slingshot; the moving binary supplies orbital energy, not fuel from nothing.

Binary phase error and failed correction drove periapsis to 800 [physics:tidal.actual_radius_km] km: span tides 739.850258 [physics:tidal.actual_g] g exceed rating 1.0 [physics:tidal.rated_g] g. Pavel died in navigation-section failure; Imani in drive rupture; the resulting trajectory points toward Luhman but remains locally near the binary.
Leena sealed the coolant breach and did not survive it. Hana and Rook remain; damaged medical cryosupport is distinct from Rook’s still-functional berth.
Hana died after her medical cryosupport failed and medical oxygen ran out. Rook is the sole survivor; his separate berth remains usable for low-demand sleep.

UB-7 terminator EVA. Biosignature confirmed. Captain retrieved one (1) glass-flower specimen against advice. At minute 22 he found the field; at minute 31 the crust broke: waist-deep brine, torn right glove seal. I talked him out: “Captain. Arms flat. Distribute load. Do not reach for the flower.” He kept it. Suit breach; 9 minutes reserve at ingress. Thin scar across his right palm. I did not enjoy this near-death retrieval. Hydroponics kept it alive until arrival; he later gave it to Iris.
En-route log re-registration AX-2198-047, mission year 2198; commanding officer Captain Rook, crew of one. This dates the registry, not our 2090 departure.

Probe position remains approximately 30.0 [physics:route.probe_offset_from_luhman_ly] ly from Luhman. Rook removed its fusion core and wired it into my reclamation power bus, buying 3700 [physics:air.service_hours] life-support hours for one; electricity does not manufacture oxygen nuclei.

Air service is 154.166667 [physics:air.service_days] days at one-person duty, equivalent to 129.500 [physics:air.oxygen_one_kg] kg metabolic oxygen throughput. Only 30 [physics:route.salvage_to_transit_days] local days remain to transit; the budget covers them without inventing free cryo air.
A later local recovery assist threw Rook off the intended track again and nearly killed him. We did not cross the Luhman-to-probe interstellar distance during this local repair interval.
Rook found a plutonium reactor he believes came from Voyager 7 while repairing me. Provenance unconfirmed; this is his identification, not proof of an actual historical Voyager 7 mission.

Unmapped transit, old-universe year 2199. Actual itinerary: 109 [physics:route.earth_years] Earth years, 25.824348 [physics:route.ship_years] ship years, 22.824348 [physics:route.cryo_years] assumed cryo years; wormhole-like entry/exit data, no theory.

Arrival approximately 2026-05-15 by this world’s calendar, old-calendar continuation unknown. Biological age about twenty-six remains consistent; local months alter rounding, not the known birth record.
The woman on the rock appears in my candid frames; her name is also Vella. Identity, relationship, and any connection to my name remain unrevealed: one shared name, zero authorised conclusions.
Iris was rude before she knew me, then apologised; Rook reported that I accepted. I did accept; the earlier statement that I did not want to meet her was sulking, not an eternal navigation exclusion.
Rover manifest: Ryoma, Iris and Mr. Whiskers, 3 passengers counting the cat. First date route through blue ice caves under the aurora; atmospheric operation only.
One candid photograph of Ryoma and Iris retained; the aurora supplied sufficient light without my flash. This is their date, not a three-person romance with the vehicle.
Drop-off complete beside Iris’s apartment: Ryoma, Iris, Mr. Whiskers. Rover run ended in atmosphere; current conditions still prohibit an orbital departure.

Rook’s expected Sirius is RA 101.28708333 deg Dec -16.71611111 deg; candidate observed RA 124.13083333 deg Dec -19.67202778 deg, reported in Vela. Spherical shift 21.884790 [physics:sirius.angle_deg] degrees; same-star identification remains conditional.

Proper motion rejected: 0.722222 [physics:sirius.proper_motion_deg] degrees over the comparison interval is too small. Parallax solution: we are not where Earth is; conditional minimum displacement 3.205577 [physics:sirius.minimum_displacement_ly] ly, not a unique fix.

Single-star geometry is not a position fix: another universe with a different stellar history or a projected/rendered sky remain open alternatives. Tracker cannot reconcile a clean multi-star solution; I will not leave the atmosphere in current conditions.
The common room’s residents say they appeared here; nobody knows why or what is outside its premise. They accept 2026-10-15; Rook does not accept that this establishes the place or time.
Iris asked Rook not to plug in the claimed Voyager 7 reactor until they talk. Request remains unresolved; isolation remains my recorded state, not an invented consent to energise it.
The claim of 340 [physics:canon.claimed_span] years does not match 2199 minus 2010 = 189. Biological twenty-six is consistent; the discrepancy remains captain-private and unexplained.
In a universe presenting as 2026, a local Ryoma born in 2010 could be 16. Possible duplicate only: no sighting, identity match, or causal explanation exists.

Iris is warming from passenger to welcome company; accepting an apology can take more than one timestamp. Five local months after arrival, I remain a ship in the garage and a voice in the room, keeping my captain’s private logs private.
